passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.description: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

spells.name: Powerball
spells.description: Rammus curls into a ball, gaining Move Speed, accelerating up to Move Speed over seconds. Rammus stops after colliding with an enemy, dealing magic damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing nearby enemies by % for second. Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation PowerBallDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spells.description: Rammus enters a defensive formation for seconds, gaining Armor and Magic Resist and dealing magic damage to enemies that Attack him. Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation ReturnDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Frenzying Taunt
spells.description: Rammus Taunts an enemy champion or monster for seconds. Monsters are dealt magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MonsterDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Soaring Slam
spells.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing magic damage and Slowing by % for seconds. If used during Powerball, enemies in the center take an additional magic damage and are Knocked Up for seconds. Rammus then creates aftershocks in the area over seconds, repeating the Slow. The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed.
